// Dance Dance Revolution online: the disc patch as runtime codes.
//
// For Cheat Device PS2 on a FreeMcBoot console booting the ORIGINAL,
// unpatched disc.  Same edits as tools/isopatch.py writes into an ISO;
// you need one or the other, never both.
//
// Generated by tools/mkcheats.py from patches/patches.json, with every
// byte verified against a retail image.  Do not hand-edit.
//
// Turn the Enable Code on for whichever game you are booting.  It is a
// 9-type hook: the engine compares the opcode at that address before it
// installs itself, so the codes cannot fire on the loader, and the two
// games cannot fire on each other.
//
// Getting past DNAS is all these do.  The console still has to resolve
// the konamionline.com names to your server.  See docs/cheats.md.
//
// Every address, opcode and byte below was read out of a retail image
// and checked before it was written here.  A console boot with these
// codes is the one thing that has not been done; docs/cheats.md says
// what to look at if one of them misbehaves.

// ========================================================================
"Dance Dance Revolution Extreme 2 (USA) [SLUS-21174]"

// Installs the code engine, and only on this disc.
Enable Code (must be on)
90118620 00832021

// DNAS bypass. Sony's DNAS servers are permanently offline, so the check can
// never pass. 0x001d5280 is the login-side DNAS wrapper; its caller only
// reads the return value (1 = ok / 0 = busy / -1 = error), so returning 1
// immediately is sufficient. Patched here rather than at the poll
// (0x008685b0) because that address lives in the DATA07.BIN overlay, and
// vaddr 0x00850000 is an aliased slot shared by seven overlays. 0x001d5280
// is inside PH0 (0x00100000-0x00764a00), always mapped.
DNAS bypass (required)
201D5280 03E00008
201D5284 24020001

// ========================================================================
"Dance Dance Revolution SuperNOVA (USA) [SLUS-21377]"

// Installs the code engine, and only on this disc.
Enable Code (must be on)
901273B8 00832021

// DNAS2 bypass. DNAS2 is never defeated, only its verdict overridden:
// obj+0x58 == 5 ('Authenticated.') is the entire definition of 'DNAS
// passed', and it is read in exactly one place -- the DNAS scene's state-10
// handler. This forces result type 5 without consulting the DNAS2 library,
// then lets the game's own code fall through to state 0x0b. This MUST be a
// file patch, not a pnach: 0x00a46000 is an overlay slot that nine modules
// take turns in -- the boot ELF maps nine program headers there, DATA03
// (net_mas4) and DATA04 (netlby_mas4) among them -- and an unconditional
// runtime patch corrupts whichever one is resident. A cheat engine that can
// test memory before writing is a different matter; see docs/cheats.md.
//
// The two D lines are that test. They compare the halves of 0c2a2078, the
// word at +000fc0 that the first write replaces, and let the 4 writes
// through only for the module that has it. None of the other 12 modules on
// the disc does, which mkcheats.py checks before emitting this. Once the
// writes land the signature is gone and they go quiet; load net_mas4 again
// and they re-apply.
DNAS bypass (required)
D0A46FC2 05000C2A
D0A46FC0 04002078
20A46FC0 24030005
20A46FC4 AE030058
20A46FC8 00001021
20A46FCC 00000000

// Repoint the service table's HTTP URLs at a port of our own, so the server
// does not need 80 or 443, which a home machine often has in use. DATA08's
// URL parser picks a default port by scheme then honours an explicit ':port'
// (0x00abed64 selects 0x50/0x1bb, 0x00abedac scans for ':'), so an explicit
// port is enough -- no code patch needed. Paths are shortened to make room,
// which is free because we serve them ourselves. Each replacement is
// NUL-padded out to the original slot.
Service URLs -> this project's web server
202FBB04 642F2F3A
202FBB08 65773278
202FBB0C 6F6B2E62
202FBB10 696D616E
202FBB14 696C6E6F
202FBB18 632E656E
202FBB1C 313A6D6F
202FBB20 30383539
202FBB24 7264642F
202FBB28 722F6E73
202FBB2C 722F6765
202FBB30 682E6765
202FBB34 006C6D74
202FBB38 68000000
202FBB3C 3A707474
202FBB40 78642F2F
202FBB44 62657732
202FBB48 6E6F6B2E
202FBB4C 6F696D61
202FBB50 6E696C6E
202FBB54 6F632E65
202FBB58 39313A6D
202FBB5C 2F303835
202FBB60 73726464
202FBB64 65722F6E

202FBB6C 74682E67

202FBB9C 6E737264

202FBBD0 39313A6D
202FBBD4 2F303835
202FBBD8 692F5756

// ========================================================================
"Dance Dance Revolution SuperNOVA 2 (USA) [SLUS-21608]"

// Installs the code engine, and only on this disc.
Enable Code (must be on)
90128C00 00832021

// DNAS2 bypass, the same override as SuperNOVA's: force obj+0x58 = 5
// ('Authenticated.') instead of asking the DNAS2 library, then let the
// game's own code take the success path to state 0x0b. Same function, same
// library (DATA07 net_dnas is unchanged but for its relocation), rebuilt at
// a new base. The one difference is that SuperNOVA 2 inlines the -8 error
// path where SuperNOVA branched to it, so the compare after the call is a
// bne over that block rather than a beq into it; the patch turns it into an
// unconditional branch to the success path. A file patch for the same reason
// as SuperNOVA's: 0x00976000 is an overlay slot shared by DATA03 (net_rel4)
// and DATA04 (netlby_rel4).
//
// The two D lines are that test. They compare the halves of 0c26e078, the
// word at +000fb0 that the first write replaces, and let the 4 writes
// through only for the module that has it. None of the other 12 modules on
// the disc does, which mkcheats.py checks before emitting this. Once the
// writes land the signature is gone and they go quiet; load net_rel4 again
// and they re-apply.
DNAS bypass (required)
D0976FB2 05000C26
D0976FB0 0400E078
20976FB0 24030005
20976FB4 AE030058
20976FB8 00001021
20976FBC 10000006

// Repoint the service table's HTTP URLs at web_port, as for SuperNOVA.
// SuperNOVA 2 moved its host to www.ddr.konamionline.com and its paths under
// /ddrsn2/; the paths are shortened to /ddrsn2/reg/ and /V2/info/ so they
// fit their slots and do not collide with SuperNOVA's on the shared web
// service. Its gate (game.ddr.konamionline.com, 29573/29570) and STUN host
// (ddrsnstun) need no patch.
Service URLs -> this project's web server
2032DE7C 772F2F3A
